text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report seeks to amend the licence fee for the encroachment agreement authorized pursuant to Item TE19.27 , adopted by Toronto and East York Community Council at its meeting on October 15, 2020.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the Item until the May 28, 2026 meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council.
